+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from google.cloud import monitoring_v3
+
+
+def _parse_timestamp(value: str) -> datetime:
+    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
+        return parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+
+
+def _point_value(point: Any) -> Optional[float]:
+    if point.value.int64_value is not None:
+        return float(point.value.int64_value)
+    if point.value.double_value is not None:
+        return float(point.value.double_value)
+    if point.value.distribution_value is not None:
+        return float(point.value.distribution_value.mean)
+    return None
+
+
+def fetch_series(project_id: str, metric_type: str, window_minutes: int, filter_expr: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    client = monitoring_v3.MetricServiceClient()
+    project_name = f"projects/{project_id}"
+    end_time = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+    start_time = end_time - timedelta(minutes=window_minutes)
+    interval = monitoring_v3.TimeInterval(
+        end_time={"seconds": int(end_time.timestamp())},
+        start_time={"seconds": int(start_time.timestamp())},
+    )
+    series = client.list_time_series(
+        request={
+            "name": project_name,
+            "filter": f'metric.type = "{metric_type}" and {filter_expr}',
+            "interval": interval,
+            "view": monitoring_v3.ListTimeSeriesRequest.TimeSeriesView.FULL,
+        }
+    )
+    rows = []
+    for ts in series:
+        for point in ts.points:
+            rows.append(
+                {
+                    "metric": ts.metric.type,
+                    "resource_type": ts.resource.type,
+                    "resource_labels": dict(ts.resource.labels),
+                    "timestamp": point.interval.end_time.ToDatetime().astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                    "value": _point_value(point),
+                }
+            )
+    rows.sort(key=lambda item: item["timestamp"])
+    return rows
+
+
+def compare_metric_series(
+    project_id: str,
+    metric_type: str,
+    left_filter: str,
+    right_filter: str,
+    window_minutes: int = 60,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    left = fetch_series(project_id, metric_type, window_minutes, left_filter)
+    right = fetch_series(project_id, metric_type, window_minutes, right_filter)
+    left_values = [p["value"] for p in left if p["value"] is not None]
+    right_values = [p["value"] for p in right if p["value"] is not None]
+    return {
+        "provider": "google_cloud_monitoring",
+        "project_id": project_id,
+        "metric_type": metric_type,
+        "window_minutes": window_minutes,
+        "left": {"filter": left_filter, "points": left, "average": (sum(left_values) / len(left_values)) if left_values else None},
+        "right": {"filter": right_filter, "points": right, "average": (sum(right_values) / len(right_values)) if right_values else None},
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    project_id = os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"]
+    metric_type = os.environ["METRIC_TYPE"]
+    left_filter = os.environ["LEFT_FILTER"]
+    right_filter = os.environ["RIGHT_FILTER"]
+    window_minutes = int(os.getenv("WINDOW_MINUTES", "60"))
+    result = compare_metric_series(project_id, metric_type, left_filter, right_filter, window_minutes)
+    print(result)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+GRAFANA_CLOUD_METRICS_API = "https://prometheus-prod-10-prod-us-central-0.grafana.net/api/prom"
+
+
+def _build_query(metric: str, labels: Dict[str, str]) -> str:
+    if not labels:
+        return metric
+    matchers = []
+    for key, value in labels.items():
+        escaped = value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"')
+        matchers.append(f'{key}="{escaped}"')
+    return f'{metric}{{{",".join(matchers)}}}'
+
+
+def query_metric_data(metric: str, labels: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None, time: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    labels = labels or {}
+    base_url = os.environ.get("GRAFANA_CLOUD_PROMETHEUS_URL", GRAFANA_CLOUD_METRICS_API).rstrip("/")
+    username = os.environ.get("GRAFANA_CLOUD_PROMETHEUS_USERNAME")
+    api_key = os.environ.get("GRAFANA_CLOUD_API_KEY")
+    if not username or not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing Grafana Cloud credentials: GRAFANA_CLOUD_PROMETHEUS_USERNAME and GRAFANA_CLOUD_API_KEY")
+
+    query = _build_query(metric, labels)
+    params = {"query": query}
+    if time:
+        params["time"] = time
+
+    response = requests.get(
+        f"{base_url}/api/v1/query",
+        params=params,
+        auth=(username, api_key),
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    if payload.get("status") != "success":
+        raise RuntimeError(payload)
+    return payload
+
+
+def main(argv: List[str]) -> int:
+    if len(argv) < 2:
+        print(json.dumps({"error": "usage: filter_metric_dimensions.py METRIC [key=value ...]"}))
+        return 1
+
+    metric = argv[1]
+    labels: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for item in argv[2:]:
+        if "=" not in item:
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid label filter: {item}")
+        key, value = item.split("=", 1)
+        labels[key] = value
+
+    print(json.dumps(query_metric_data(metric, labels), indent=2, sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))
*** End Patch

+import os
+import time
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+@dataclass
+class MetricStats:
+    count: int
+    sum: float
+    average: float
+    minimum: float
+    maximum: float
+
+
+class DatadogMetricStatsClient:
+    def __init__(self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, app_key: Optional[str] = None, site: Optional[str] = None):
+        self.api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("DATADOG_API_KEY")
+        self.app_key = app_key or os.environ.get("DATADOG_APP_KEY")
+        self.site = site or os.environ.get("DATADOG_SITE", "datadoghq.com")
+        if not self.api_key or not self.app_key:
+            raise ValueError("DATADOG_API_KEY and DATADOG_APP_KEY are required")
+
+    def aggregate_metric_stats(self, metric_name: str, start_ts: int, end_ts: int, interval: int = 300, aggregator: str = "avg") -> MetricStats:
+        url = f"https://api.{self.site}/api/v1/query"
+        params = {
+            "from": start_ts,
+            "to": end_ts,
+            "query": f"{aggregator}:{metric_name}{{*}}.rollup({interval})",
+        }
+        headers = {
+            "DD-API-KEY": self.api_key,
+            "DD-APPLICATION-KEY": self.app_key,
